title: 音画同源控制模型：从极简输入到可靠现场系统
titleEn: Performance Control Model: From Minimal Input to Reliable Live Systems
summary: 借用控制论、数字乐器与现场编排的基本问题，把 State、Feedback、Stability、Controllability、Quantization 与 Shared State 翻译成一套可以直接试玩、验证并用于 Live A/V 系统的工作模型。
summaryEn: A working model that translates state, feedback, stability, controllability, quantization and shared-state thinking into practical live audiovisual system design.
